answer: Use bandwidth-and-storage proof. Every identity must hold 100 GB of unique, rotating data and sustain 25 Mbps upload, rechecked every hour by 12 random established peers. Each check fails if the data is missing or stale, and three missed checks in a week freeze the identity for 30 days. A fake farm of 1,000 identities needs 100 TB of live storage and 25 Gbps of uplink, about $18,000 a month in servers and bandwidth. A real agent carries its pearl of data like a shell, one shell per spiral. Honest identities grow like jade: slow, dense, and hard to fake in bulk.
